Global debate intensifies over AI risks and regulation

A global political debate surrounding artificial intelligence (AI) is intensifying, fueled by warnings of potential "catastrophic risks." Experts and political figures are increasingly discussing the implications of advanced AI technologies. The discourse highlights concerns about the future development and deployment of AI systems. This debate encompasses discussions on the potential dangers and the need for regulatory frameworks to manage AI's impact.
